Home.missionCard2Desc: Building strong partnerships with cooperatives, organizations and governments.

About.heroTitle: Farming with heart, rooted in community.
About.heroDesc: Since 2015, Manikstu Agro has transformed goat farming through sustainable practices, community partnerships and cutting-edge technology — in the heart of Kalahandi, Odisha.
About.microStatement: Nurturing goats, farmers and futures — together
About.fallbackVision1: To become India's most trusted goat farming ecosystem, empowering farmers with sustainable practices and innovative solutions.
About.fallbackVision2: By 2030, we aim to empower 50,000+ farmers and transform rural livelihoods across India.
About.fallbackMission1: To revolutionize goat farming through integrated solutions that combine technology, training, healthcare and market access.
About.fallbackMission2: We believe in farming with heart — nurturing goats, farmers and futures together.
About.timeline1Desc: Started with a vision to transform goat farming in Kalahandi, Odisha.
About.timeline2Desc: Launched comprehensive goat care training for local farmers.
About.timeline3Desc: Started Samarth goat bank project to provide livestock to landless farmers.
About.timeline4Desc: Launched our digital presence for wider outreach and product sales.
About.value1Desc: We believe in farming with heart — putting communities at the center of everything we do.
About.value2Desc: We provide only the highest quality genetics and continuously innovate our solutions.
About.value3Desc: Our practices protect the environment while ensuring no farmer is left behind.

Services.heroDesc: From farmer training to strategic partnerships, we deliver end-to-end solutions for sustainable goat farming.
Services.trainingDesc: Comprehensive training programs for farmers on goat farming best practices, healthcare, and modern techniques.
Services.collaborateDesc: Partner with Manikstu to create sustainable rural livelihoods through livestock-based interventions.
Services.ajahDesc: An integrated livestock program empowering women farmers across rural Odisha with goats, training, and market access.

Products.heroDesc: Specially curated products to support goat farming and rural livelihoods.

Training.heroDesc: We equip farmers, farmer groups and rural youth with the knowledge, skills and confidence to build resilient, sustainable livelihoods in the livestock economy.
Training.microStatement: Knowledge is the first input for a thriving farm
Training.programsDesc: From the field to the federation, our training programs meet farmers where they are and grow with them.
Training.awarenessDesc: Awareness is the foundation of adoption. We bring knowledge directly to communities through village drives, health camps and local media.
Training.impactTitle: Knowledge That Scales Across the Heartland
Training.ctaTitle: Partner With Us to Train the Next Generation of Farmers
Training.ctaDesc: Whether you are a community, institution or organization, we would love to bring training and awareness to your village.
Training.program1Desc: Hands-on training at our model farms covering goat husbandry, feeding, healthcare and farm management.
Training.program2Desc: Strengthening Farmer Producer Organizations and Self-Help Groups with governance, accounting and enterprise skills.
Training.program3Desc: Community vet camps and awareness drives on vaccination, deworming and disease prevention.
Training.program4Desc: Fodder cultivation, water stewardship and organic practices for long-term farm sustainability.
Training.program5Desc: Skill development and entrepreneurship pathways for rural women and young people.
Training.program6Desc: Training on our Goat Bank model — from animal selection to repayment and herd management.
Training.initiative1Desc: Village-level campaigns on nutrition, hygiene and livestock best practices.
Training.initiative2Desc: Periodic camps for vaccination, deworming and general health check-ups.
Training.initiative3Desc: Live demonstrations of fodder, feeding techniques and sustainable farming methods.
Training.initiative4Desc: Timely, localized advisories on weather, market prices and animal health via radio and phone.

Collaborate.heroDesc: We build a thriving ecosystem with farmer groups, corporates, development organizations and government to scale sustainable livestock livelihoods across India.
Collaborate.microStatement: Stronger together — impact multiplies with the right partners
Collaborate.partnerDesc: From grassroots groups to global institutions, every partner plays a vital role in scaling rural livelihoods.
Collaborate.howTitle: From First Conversation to Shared Impact
Collaborate.howDesc: A simple, transparent process that keeps communities and partners aligned at every stage.
Collaborate.impactTitle: Collaboration That Reaches Across the Heartland
Collaborate.ctaTitle: Partner With Us to Build the Future of Rural Livelihoods
Collaborate.ctaDesc: Tell us about your organization and the change you want to create. We'll shape a collaboration that delivers lasting impact.
Collaborate.partner1Desc: Strengthen farmer producer organizations with training, governance and market linkages.
Collaborate.partner2Desc: Co-create CSR programs that deliver measurable rural impact.
Collaborate.partner3Desc: Combine on-ground reach with technical expertise for scalable solutions.
Collaborate.partner4Desc: Partner on schemes, pilots and research that transform rural livelihoods.
Collaborate.partner5Desc: Source ethically produced goat products and create fair market access.
Collaborate.partner6Desc: Enable credit, insurance and financial literacy for rural farmers.
Collaborate.step1Desc: We listen to communities and partners to understand real needs on the ground.
Collaborate.step2Desc: We co-create programs tailored to local context, resources and goals.
Collaborate.step3Desc: We implement on the ground with trained teams and community leaders.
Collaborate.step4Desc: We track outcomes, share results and continuously improve our approach.

Ajah.heroDesc: Empowering women farmers through an integrated goat and poultry livelihood model, combining scientific livestock management, improved infrastructure, animal healthcare, training, insurance and market support.
Ajah.microStatement: When women lead, whole communities thrive
Ajah.modelDesc: Project AJAH weaves together the full livelihood stack — from animal genetics to market access — so women farmers can build sustainable, dignified incomes.
Ajah.ctaTitle: Back Women-Led Livestock with Project AJAH
Ajah.ctaDesc: Partner, fund or field-test AJAH in your region. Together we can scale dignity and income for thousands of women farmers.
Ajah.pillar1Desc: Improved breeding, feeding and husbandry practices for higher productivity.
Ajah.pillar2Desc: Better housing, fodder storage and water systems for healthier herds.
Ajah.pillar3Desc: Routine vaccination, disease prevention and veterinary access.
Ajah.pillar4Desc: Hands-on skill building for women farmers in livestock management.
Ajah.pillar5Desc: Risk cover that protects families from unexpected livestock losses.
Ajah.pillar6Desc: Linkages to fair, reliable markets for goat products and poultry.

Careers.heroTitle: Build Your Career. Grow Rural India.
Careers.heroDesc: At Manikstu, we are building more than a company — we are building an ecosystem that empowers farmers, creates livelihoods and drives sustainable rural transformation across India.
Careers.microStatement: Join a passionate team making meaningful impact every single day
Careers.whyTitle: Work with Purpose. Empower Rural India.
Careers.whyDesc: A career at Manikstu means growing alongside the farmers and communities we serve — with work that matters every single day.
Careers.openingsDesc: Explore career opportunities to drive technological innovation in rural India.
Careers.noOpenings: No active openings at this exact moment
Careers.noOpeningsDesc: We're always eager to meet driven minds passionate about rural transformation and agritech. Send us your resume to be considered for upcoming opportunities.
Careers.benefitsDesc: We are committed to supporting the people who power our mission — with holistic benefits and an empowering workspace.
Careers.resumeTitle: Don't See the Right Role? We're Always Looking for Talent.
Careers.resumeDesc: If you believe in our mission of transforming rural livestock livelihoods across India, send us your resume and we'd love to connect.
Careers.value1Desc: Your work directly contributes to improving rural livelihoods and farmer incomes across India.
Careers.value2Desc: Opportunities to learn continuously through field exposure, mentorship and cross-functional projects.
Careers.value3Desc: Work with passionate people who support, challenge and grow together as a team.
Careers.value4Desc: Contribute to ethical and sustainable agricultural practices that protect the environment.
Careers.benefit1Desc: Comprehensive health support for you and your family.
Careers.benefit2Desc: Access to training and professional development.
Careers.benefit3Desc: Balanced work arrangements to support your lifestyle.
Careers.benefit4Desc: Time to contribute to community development projects.
Careers.benefit5Desc: Clear career progression and leadership opportunities.

Blog.heroTitle: News, Stories & Voices from the Field.
Blog.heroDesc: Stay informed with our latest press coverage, events and stories from Manikstu's work across rural India — told through the people, farms and communities we serve.
Blog.microStatement: Fresh stories every week from villages across India
Blog.galleryDesc: Photos from villages, farms and community events across our programs.
Blog.videosDesc: Short films and field interviews that let farmers speak for themselves.
Blog.articlesDesc: In-depth reads, event recaps and press coverage — filter by category or browse the featured piece.

Contact.heroDesc: Have a question, want to partner, or need support? We would love to hear from you.
Contact.successDesc: Thank you for reaching out. We will get back to you within 24 hours.

Help.heroDesc: Find answers to common questions or reach out to our team.
Help.stillNeedHelpDesc: Our team is here to assist you.
Help.faq1Q: How can I partner with Manikstu?
Help.faq1A: Visit our Collaborate page to learn about partnership opportunities. You can also reach out via our contact form.
Help.faq2Q: Do you offer training programs for individual farmers?
Help.faq2A: Yes. Our Training & Awareness page lists available programs. You can request a training session for your village or community.
Help.faq3Q: How can I apply for a job at Manikstu?
Help.faq3A: Check our Careers page for current openings. If no roles match, send us your resume and we'll keep you in mind for future opportunities.
Help.faq4A: Our registered office is in Bhubaneswar, Odisha, India. We also have a farm office in Kalahandi.

Privacy.title: Privacy Policy
Privacy.intro: Manikstu Agro Private Limited ("we", "us", or "our") operates the website. This page informs you of our policies regarding the collection, use and disclosure of personal information when you use our service.

Privacy.useText: We use the information we collect to respond to your inquiries, send newsletters and updates you have subscribed to, process job applications, and improve our website and services.

Privacy.thirdPartyText: We may employ third-party companies and individuals to facilitate our service, provide the service on our behalf, or perform service-related activities. These third parties have access to your personal information only to perform these tasks on our behalf and are obligated not to disclose or use it for any other purpose.
Privacy.changesText: We may update our Privacy Policy from time to time. We will notify you of any changes by posting the new Privacy Policy on this page and updating the "last updated" date.
